svg.title: Non-Mendelian inheritance: mitochondrial DNA disease passes only through the mother and varies by heteroplasmy and threshold, nuclear mitochondrial disease follows Mendelian patterns, and triple nucleotide repeat disorders (Huntington disease, myotonic dystrophy) are autosomal dominant with anticipation, read by repeat size; each column gives inheritance, presentation, testing and treatment

svg.text: Non-Mendelian inheritance: WHAT does the family tree and the patient show?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • high-energy tissues (brain, retina, skeletal muscle, heart) in 2 or more systems → MITOCHONDRIAL

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • suggestive: CNS (hypotonia, ataxia, intellectual disability, seizures, migraine, dementia, sensorineural hearing loss) · eyes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: (retinitis pigmentosa, optic atrophy, nystagmus, ophthalmoplegia) · muscle weakness, exercise intolerance · heart

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • also: macrocytic anemia, pancytopenia · diabetes mellitus or insipidus, exocrine pancreas, short stature · gut

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: pseudo-obstruction · liver failure · renal tubular acidosis, Fanconi

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • worse and EARLIER in each generation → triple nucleotide REPEAT (anticipation)
